headline: Last Dance
caption:
Former UFC champ Cody Garbrandt says his next fight will be his last.
Farewell win or not? 👇

Garbrandt told MMA Junkie he's targeting the UFC's February card in Cleveland as his farewell, with one fight left on his deal and no opponent named yet. The Ohio native took the bantamweight title from Dominick Cruz at UFC 207 in 2016.

🔥 Hot take: Peak Garbrandt beating Cruz is still one of bantamweight's best nights.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Farewell win?
hot_take: Peak No Love was *elite* at bantamweight.

v2.story: Ex-champ Cody Garbrandt plans to retire after a UFC Cleveland fight in February.
